csv.title: Import a writing task from CSV
csv.subtitle: One file builds one task, and it fills in this builder so you can check it before publishing.
csv.applied: The spreadsheet filled in the task. Check it, then publish.
csv.failed: That file could not be read as a CSV.
csv.help: The file has to follow these rules, or nothing is imported:
csv.rule1: One file is one writing task.
csv.rule2: Rows are counted from the first row under the headers, so that row is Row 2.
csv.rule3: Put every part and every mark line on its own row, and write the task columns (title, instructions, word bank) the same way on every row.
csv.rule4: Wrap any cell that contains a comma in quote marks. Inside one cell, separate list items with | (word bank, joining words, criteria, applies to).
csv.rule5: yes or no cells take yes or no. due_date is written YYYY-MM-DD. section_order and rubric_order start at 1 with no gaps.
csv.rule6: rubric_applies_to must name a section_name from this same file, or * for every part.
csv.rule7: One wrong row rejects the whole file and names it. Nothing is saved until you publish, and the class stays your choice here.
